KO.headline: Coca-Cola Officer Nancy Quan Reports Sale of Common Shares
KO.summary: Coca-Cola officer Nancy Quan disclosed the planned sale of 20,585 common shares on November 5, 2026.

KO.headline: Nvidia Stock Is Now Cheaper Than a Toilet-Paper Company, Data Shows
KO.summary: Nvidia's forward P/E fell to 15.2x, below Kimberly-Clark's 15.5x. The AI chipmaker now trades cheaper than 22 of 33 consumer staples stocks.

KO.headline: Coca-Cola System Invests $1.22 Million in Namibia Water Security Project
KO.summary: The Coca-Cola system is investing $1.22 million in the //Gam-i Swakop Basin Resilience Project to support water security and ecosystem restoration in Namibia.

KO.headline: Coca-Cola Insider Executes Share Sale
KO.summary: An insider at The Coca-Cola Company sold shares valued at approximately $6.41 million, according to a recent SEC filing.

KO.headline: Coca-Cola Pakistan Receives Sustainability Award for Plastic Road Project
KO.summary: Coca-Cola Pakistan was honored with a Sustainability Award for its collaboration on the country's first plastic road in Islamabad.

KO.headline: Coca-Cola India Launches Limited-Edition Limca Punjab Special Can
KO.summary: Coca-Cola India has introduced a limited-edition 'Limca Punjab Special Can' as part of its 'One State, One Can' initiative to celebrate local culture and heritage.
